---
title: Cantor Schedule
---

St. Egbert's is grateful for our cantors who regularly share their time and talent leading the congregation in song. Your courage and dedication is appreciated.

If you are unable to make or cantor at a Mass for which you are scheduled, please make every attempt to find a replacement. If you are unable to find someone, please notify the music director as soon as possible.

::: {.callout-note}

The private (non-public) calendar below is accessible via invite only and requires a Gmail account to view.

:::
